note: What the page reads off the room's GLB instead of keeping in code (spec S7.2, S7.3, S8): the opening camera, the camera's box and the live lights, written into the GLB as named empties by shared/add_room_data.mjs. A position is in the GLB's own coordinates (three's: y up). `view_open` is where the camera opens, its `target`, the `span` the room is framed across and the `height` it is framed up (world units) at the `aspect` the owner framed it in by hand, 2026-11-15 (the view the prototype's ROOM_VIEW held). `bounds_min` and `bounds_max` are the box the camera stays in: inside the side walls (-7.89 and 9.89), 0.3 clear of the back wall (z -0.5), far enough back that the nearest the camera may stand to its target, 1.5 (the page's minDistance), is inside the box (#620), above the floor and below the ceiling (12), and 0.548 short of the front wall that closes the room (z 13, #620). `view_open` is the owner's 2026-11-15 line of sight, moved along itself to stand inside that box: the page frames along it, and brings the camera in along it when the box cannot hold it farther out. Each light carries the values the prototype's room lighting held, which agree with the lamp that baked the room: the key stands on the line from the bookcase's middle through the bulb (5.31, 4.85, 2.28), so the books' shadows fall the way the baked ones do. A light's height is `of_height` times the bookcase's height, plus the position's y, as the shelf's own lights are. Only the key casts.
